description: Gravitative Massenbewegungen - Observed Event (Media) Österreich is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geometadatensuche.inspire.gv.at. Gravitative mass movements identified on the basis of media and literature information. INSPIRE compliant dataset (object type Observed Event) according to the data specification for Natural Risk Zones (D2.8.III.12). Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE Gravitative Mass Movements - Observed Event (Media) United Kingdom" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Erdfall, GeoSphere, gravitative Massenbewegung, Steinschlag, inspireidentifiziert, GBA. The listing shows 5 download or service links in ATOM, WMS, OGCFEAT. The listing shows 2025-02-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
